description: Get the current Contentful space, including its id, name, default environment, locales, creation time, and organization.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the space object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all content types defined in the space, returned as a Contentful collection.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a collection object with items (each a content type with a sys envelope); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single content type by its id.

content_type_id.description: The unique id of the content type.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the content type object; on failure (content type not found), output contains an error message.

description: List entries, optionally filtered by content type and field equality, with pagination via limit and skip.

content_type.description: Optional content type id to filter entries by.

field_filters.description: Optional mapping of field name to value for simple equality filtering on entry fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-1000, default 100).

skip.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a collection object with total, skip, limit, and items; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single entry by its id.

entry_id.description: The unique id of the entry.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the entry object; on failure (entry not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new entry of a given content type with the provided fields.

content_type.description: The id of the content type the new entry belongs to.

fields.description: Optional mapping of field values for the new entry.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created entry object; on failure (content type not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the fields of an existing entry by its id.

entry_id.description: The unique id of the entry to update.

fields.description: Optional mapping of field values to merge into the entry's existing fields.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated entry object; on failure (entry not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete an entry by its id.

entry_id.description: The unique id of the entry to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the deleted entry id and a deleted flag; on failure (entry not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all assets in the space, returned as a Contentful collection.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a collection object with items (each an asset with a sys envelope); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single asset by its id.

asset_id.description: The unique id of the asset.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the asset object; on failure (asset not found), output contains an error message.
